entries.en: Somebody needed to set that thing straight, and it obviously wasn't going to be you.
Sorry. I'll let you know if I come up with something.
I think you should let the hanar preach in the Presidium.
You're suppressing that hanar's religious freedom. I want you to stop.
Are there laws being broken here?
You should be more tolerant. It's just trying to express its beliefs.
Because it's a big stupid jellyfish.
What's the purpose behind the evangelical permits?
So if the hanar gets a permit, it's allowed to preach?
Why don't you just arrest the hanar?
If you'd like, I could talk to the hanar for you.
If you can't solve this problem, you don't even deserve to be in C-Sec.
Let the hanar talk.
Leave the hanar alone.
Be more open-minded.
It's not smart enough.
Reason for permit
Rules of permit
Arrest it
Let me talk to it.
You're pathetic.
As long as it stays in approved areas once it has the permit, yes. That would solve the issue for me.
I'm not concerned with diplomatic incidents. I'm concerned with the law being broken!
Not yet, but any good C-Sec officer removes problems before they create a public nuisance.
I suppose I can tell my superior that I attempted a diplomatic solution.
Some other C-Sec officer can arrest the hanar. It is no longer my problem. Thank you for your assistance.
I don't care what you have to do. Just get rid of that hanar.
You've explained the law. If the hanar gets in trouble, it has nobody to blame but itself.
If you want to get promoted, learn to pick your battles. Let it go.
If I purchased the evangelical permit myself, would that take care of things?
If we harass this hanar, we're going to have a diplomatic incident.
Has anyone actually complained about this hanar?
What if I bought a permit?
This is dangerous.
It's not causing trouble.
The hanar has been warned.
You've done your job.
Drop it.
I'll keep trying.
Got a moment, Spectre?
I'm telling you, this is not what Jake would want!
Who are you to tell me what my husband would want?
I'm the only person making sense right now! You're endangering your baby!
This baby is the only thing I have left of Jake!
Anyone else hear that low hum? Sounds like it's coming from that statue. Makes my teeth tingle.
Y'know... art doesn't normally do much for me, but that relay statue? I like.
This statue shows how well the Protheans blended function and form. The mass relays were not only their greatest technological achievement, but also inspiration for beautiful works of art.
The keepers never paid much attention to that relay monument. I always found that a little strange.
I was never a fan of this statue. The krogan monument just seems more impressive to me.
The Protheans obviously understood the aesthetic value of the mass relays. Something we quarians have learned to appreciate during our wanderings.
Hello, Spectre. I have a business proposition for you.
Word travels. Your name comes up in certain circles.
Of course you do. But this would be easy work for you, and I pay extremely well.
I'm acquainted with a pair of powerful crime bosses.
They're hiding on remote worlds, and I have the coordinates. You could do the galaxy a favor.
They're red sand dealers who make victims of their customers. Those who can no longer pay are sold to batarians as slaves.
They're loathsome, hurting innocent people. They must be ended.
While I appreciate your estimation of my bravado, I have no intention of attempting to murder you.
You are the first human Spectre, and you are doing important work for humanity.
Arrested for what? You and I are simply having a conversation.
I haven't the faintest idea, but they're certain to be armed.
How did you know I'm a Spectre?
I've got plenty to do already.
What crimes did these men commit?
I eliminate them, and then you take over and try to eliminate me. How stupid do I look?
You're obviously with them. Why don't I just arrest you instead?
What kind of defenses would these two have?
I'm not interested.
How do you know me?
Good for you.
Known crimes
This is an obvious set-up.
I could charge you.
Defenses
I have no interest in red sand or slavery. Anyone who does deserves to die. Our needs are aligned.
I have excellent legal representation. Arresting me would be a waste of your time.
Their partnership soured, and each believes that the other intends to kill him. They will be well-prepared.
Here are the coordinates, nonetheless. What you do with them is your decision.
Could you really let these men live, knowing that you can stop them?
Excellent. Here are the coordinates. When these men are dead, I will wait for you at the third set of coordinates.
Goodbye, Commander. It has been a pleasure to meet you.
Find someone else to do your dirty work. I want no part of a gang war.
If they're as bad as you say they are, they need to be dealt with.
No. I won't do this.
We share interests in certain cooperative ventures.
But their business practices have forced me to terminate our relationship.
Once they are dead, I will manage our organization in a more tasteful manner.
And what do you get out of this?
Her Interest
I don't care what you think, Michael! It's my decision!
I know you're hurting, Rebekah, but don't let your grief hurt your baby, too!
This baby is the only thing my brother.... It's all I have left of him. I need to know that the baby's safe.
It's all I have left too, Michael.
I just want Jacob's child to be safe. I want to give him that much.
We will. I promise.
Thank you for talking with us. I appreciate it.
I don't have to listen to this any more, Michael.
Who asked you, anyway? Forget it, Michael. I'm leaving.
Damn it, Rebekah!
Perhaps you can talk some sense into her.
I don't need anyone to "talk sense" into me, Michael! I'm not undergoing the treatments!
My sister-in-law here is pregnant, and she's refused to let the baby undergo gene therapy in utero.
My husband, Jacob, died from a rare heart condition several months ago.
There's a chance that the baby could develop the same heart condition, but routine gene therapy can eliminate it.
A very small chance, Michael. And extranet reports say the therapy could harm the child!
It's less dangerous than the genetic enhancements that every soldier in the Alliance receives!
One in three hundred at most.
But extranet articles say there could still be long-term complications we don't know about!
Don't you understand? If my baby is that one in three hundred, I'll always wonder if I... if I killed my baby for nothing!
According to the doctors, there's a one-in-fifty chance. And if my baby develops the condition, medical treatments are available.
Which are nowhere near as effective as simply getting the gene therapy!
I don't care what you think! Who are you, anyway? It's my child. It's my decision.
I had to watch Jacob die! I can't risk causing the death of my child, as well!
But what if it ends up killing a child who would never have developed the condition? What then?
Don't you understand? I can't lose this baby! This... this is all I have left of him.
And you and that baby are all I have left of Jacob! I can't lose you, either of you. Not after this.
Then why didn't you say that instead of yelling at me?
Damn it, she's not choosing! She's acting blindly out of grief!
Of course it is! I'm the closest thing to a father this baby is going to have!
How dare you? I'm trying to do what's best for the baby!
Can I help with anything?
It's Rebekah's child, Michael. I think you should honor her decision.
I know you want the best for your brother's child, but this isn't your decision.
Is this about keeping the baby safe, or is this about you losing your last link to your brother?
Of course she is! So are you! Yelling at her won't bring your brother back.
Then support the baby's mother. Stand with her when she makes the tough decisions.
You're afraid you'll lose the baby, just like you lost your brother.
I'm sorry I couldn't help. Good luck.
Forget it. I don't have time for this.
Is this man harassing you, ma'am?
I'm certain that she has a good reason. I'd like to hear both sides.
I thought gene therapy was common.
What are the chances that gene therapy could hurt the baby?
What are the chances that your child will develop the heart condition?
For what it's worth, I think you should consider undergoing the therapy.
You've already lost your husband. Are you going to let your grief endanger the baby, too?
Your husband's death wasn't your fault. But if you refuse the therapy, your child's death could be.
Wouldn't your husband have wanted to give the baby a better chance than he had?
Alliance soldiers all go through much more rigorous genetic procedures. It's worth the risk.
Then you'll know you did all you could to keep your baby safe. That's all you can do.
Is there a problem?
Leave her alone.
That's your story.
Danger of Therapy
Chance of Disease
Get the treatment.
Let her choose.
Think of the child.
It's worth it.
Then do the safe thing.
